name: Reward Summary Contract
summary: Defines reward tiers, display milestones, readiness, redemption status, and aggregate progress fields.

response_shape.nextBreak: null or {percent, equalsLeft, secondsLeft, progressPercent, almost, durationLeft, equalsCopy, timeCopy, shortLine, mentionLine, metaLine}

failure_modes: Invalid requested tier is rejected or skipped.
Tiers unlock only when both time and equals thresholds are reached.
Display-only milestones are not represented as redeemable tier entries.
known_gaps: No backend claim contract exists for 50% or 100% milestones.

evidence.reason: Builds reward summaries, validates tier percentages, redeems tiers, and marks announcements.
Defines the source reward tiers and display milestones.
Transforms local API summary into dashboard progress and milestone presentation.
Asserts lock, ready, redeemed, and display-only milestone behavior.
